description: End-to-end test scenarios for three canonical flows. Scenario 1 (new MCP): submit new MCP via mcp_scanner, verify signal_analyser runs all enrichments, verify trust_synthesiser assigns verdict, verify attestation_engine writes attestation, verify UI shows result. Scenario 2 (threat match): ingest known-threat signal via threat_intel_ingestor, verify risk_ranker elevates score, verify verdict downgrades. Scenario 3 (admin override): set manual verdict via manual_override_api, verify audit_log entry, verify UI reflects override. Each scenario uses write_service /query to verify DB state at each step. Exits 0 on success, non-zero with diagnostic output on failure.
